# Chat

> Minimalist, account-free, ephemeral real-time chat. Create a room, share the code, and everything is deleted on exit — nothing is stored.

Chat is a browser-based anonymous chat platform with a JetBrains-inspired terminal aesthetic. Rooms are password-optional, messages auto-burn after 10 minutes, and there are no accounts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create or join a room with just a username and a room code.
- [Features](/features): AI-generated summary of what Chat can do.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Recent commits and AI-summarized release notes.
